snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun Boom – Reveal Trailer | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun Boom is coming to iOS and Android in 2026.

Fight through a massive single-player campaign across multiple worlds in this intense retro-inspired FPS set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe. Blast through relentless enemies with iconic weapons, brutal combat, fast movement, and non-stop action, fully optimised for mobile.

• Intense retro-inspired FPS combat
• Massive single-player campaign
• Iconic Warhammer 40,000 weapons and enemies
• Fast movement and brutal firefights
• Mobile-optimised controls and gameplay
• Premium experience with no ads or energy systems

See all the Skulls 2026 reveals on Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/2eknkrto/skulls-2026-the-warhammer-video-games-festival/
